[[File:Another_Chance.jpg|thumb|left|Alderaanian War Frigate [[Another Chance|''Another Chance''.]]]]
The '''Royal Alderaan Civil Fleet''', known simply as the '''Alderaan Fleet''',<ref name="GA">''[[Graveyard of Alderaan]]''</ref> was a volunteer [[Navy/Legends|defense fleet]] formed to protect the people of [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] during the [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|Separatist Crisis]] and the ensuing [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. After the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] ended, the fleet was disarmed and disbanded when Alderaan committed itself to peace, with its weapons placed on board an [[Alderaanian War Frigate]], its most powerful class of ship, named ''[[Another Chance]]'', along with three [[Thranta-class War Cruiser]]s slave-circuited to protect any vessel transmitting its [[Transponder code/Legends|IFF]] code.
